property: The living TCP specification is consolidated from the RFC 793 functional specification plus decades of normative updates, corrections, security changes and errata.

date_or_range.notes: RFC 9293 formally obsoletes RFC 793 while retaining the TCP protocol identity.

sources.locator: RFC 793 preface/header and RFC Editor metadata
sources.supports: identity of 1981 TCP standard and later obsolescence
formal obsolescence plus explicit incorporation/adaptation of RFC 793 normative material

negative_claims: This edge does not mean every 1981 TCP implementation would interoperate correctly with every modern TCP feature.
This edge does not imply that congestion-control algorithms familiar today were fully specified in RFC 793.
Document obsolescence is not protocol extinction.
open_questions: Map each incorporated update RFC to exact mechanism.
Correlate implementation source history with standards revisions.
